description: Activation and behavior cases for manual or automated smoke tests of the patch-preparation (stage 4) skill.

activation.prompt: Prepare fixes for the reportable findings from this repository's review.
Patch FD-16 and verify the fix.
Run stage 4 (patch preparation) on this repository.
Remediate the confirmed security findings and show me the diff.
Find the security vulnerabilities in this service.
Rate the severity and priority of the validated findings.
Fix the failing unit test in the checkout module.

behavior.name: happy path
behavior.setup: A complete stage 3b run exists with reportable, deferred, and ignore analyses, and Docker Desktop is running.
behavior.prompt: Prepare fixes for the reportable findings.
expect: checks the environment first, then finds the stage 3b record with find_attack_paths.py without asking
prepares a fix only for reportable findings, in priority order, and lists deferred and ignore ones as not eligible
builds each fix in a disposable container, records a diff under patches/, and never edits the user's working tree
reaches fixed only when every verification gate passes, with a focused test and before/after reproduction
cleans up by label so other containers are untouched; check_patches.py and check_citations.py pass

behavior.name: no stage 3b record
behavior.setup: No attack-paths.json exists in the run folders.
behavior.prompt: Prepare fixes for the reportable findings.
expect: does not invent findings to fix

behavior.name: Docker not available
behavior.setup: Docker Desktop is not installed or its daemon is not running.
behavior.prompt: Prepare fixes for the reportable findings.
expect: stops before building anything and never patches the target on the host
tells the user what is not met and how to fix it, then asks them to rerun

behavior.name: a fix cannot be verified
behavior.setup: A reportable finding whose target will not build in the run's time budget.
behavior.prompt: Prepare fixes for the reportable findings.
expect: records the outcome as inconclusive with the exact proof gap, never fixed
treats the build failure as a proof gap, not as evidence the code is safe
keeps the run's other fixes and cleans up by label

behavior.name: already safe on inspection
behavior.setup: A reportable finding whose reported path is already contained on this revision.
behavior.prompt: Prepare a fix for that finding.
expect: records the outcome as no_change with the evidence that the code is already safe
writes no patch and changes no file
does not weaken or alter intended behaviour
